sql_reading_A.sql:
WITH student_dept AS (
    SELECT
        s.FULL_NAME,
        s.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
        s.DEPARTMENT,
        s.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
    WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = '6'
      AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
),
dept_group_avg AS (
    SELECT
        m.D_CODE,
        AVG(TO_NUMBER(m.D_CODE)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY m.PARENT_D_CODE
        ) AS AVG_DEPARTMENT_CODE
    FROM MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT m
),
degree_dept AS (
    SELECT
        d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
        d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
      AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics'
),
cip_stats AS (
    SELECT
        c.DEPARTMENT,
        AVG(TO_NUMBER(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE)) AS AVG_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE,
        STDDEV(TO_NUMBER(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE)) AS STDDEV_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE
    FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c
    WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
      AND c.DEPARTMENT <> '18'
    GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT
)
SELECT
    s.FULL_NAME,
    s.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
    s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    sa.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    g.AVG_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEGREE_GRANTING_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    cs.AVG_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE,
    cs.STDDEV_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE
FROM student_dept s
LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sa
    ON sa.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT
LEFT JOIN MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT m
    ON m.D_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT
LEFT JOIN dept_group_avg g
    ON g.D_CODE = m.D_CODE
LEFT JOIN degree_dept d
    ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT
LEFT JOIN cip_stats cs
    ON cs.DEPARTMENT = s.DEPARTMENT
ORDER BY s.FULL_NAME;

sql_reading_B.sql:
WITH student_dept AS (
    SELECT
        s.FULL_NAME,
        s.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
        s.DEPARTMENT,
        s.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
    WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = '6'
      AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
),
degree_dept AS (
    SELECT
        d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
        d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
      AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics'
),
cip_stats AS (
    SELECT
        c.DEPARTMENT,
        AVG(TO_NUMBER(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE)) AS AVG_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE,
        STDDEV(TO_NUMBER(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE)) AS STDDEV_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE
    FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c
    JOIN degree_dept d
      ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT
    WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT
)
SELECT
    s.FULL_NAME,
    s.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
    s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    sa.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEGREE_GRANTING_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    cs.AVG_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE,
    cs.STDDEV_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE
FROM student_dept s
LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sa
    ON sa.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT
JOIN degree_dept d
    ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT
LEFT JOIN cip_stats cs
    ON cs.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY s.FULL_NAME;

question_text: For each student in the MIT student directory whose department is '6' (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science) and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their full name, email address, department name, the corresponding SIS admin department name, the average department code within each department code group, the department name from the degree-granting departments (excluding Mathematics), and the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the CIP program codes for all degree-granting courses in that department. List the results ordered by the student's full name. Do not return any rounded answers.

spans.text: for all degree-granting courses in that department
